title: Stubbornness is not a spiritual path
summary: The shabad refuses the fantasy that force of will can discover the One. Fruitful service happens when the Lord draws the seeker near, so the honest posture is surrender rather than spiritual self-assertion.
takeaway: Ask to be drawn near; stubborn force cannot find the One.
lifeApplication: When effort turns hard and self-proving, stop calling the pressure devotion. Ask to be attached by grace, then do the next act of service without trying to control arrival.

source.shortMeaning: Self-will cannot find the One; fruitful service comes when the Lord draws the seeker near.
source.lifeApplication: When striving gets hard, ask to be led rather than to force arrival.

evidence.coreClaim: Stubborn self-will cannot find the One; service becomes real when the Lord draws the seeker near.
evidence.turn: The path opens by surrendering force, not by intensifying it.
evidence.practicalImplication: When effort turns hard and self-proving, stop calling the pressure devotion. Ask to be attached by grace, then do the next act of service without trying to control arrival.
